evals.prompt: Set up the engineering-principles skills in this pnpm monorepo. Preserve our existing deployment notes in AGENTS.md and ask me to confirm the package responsibilities before writing.
evals.expected_output: Discovers only required package and command facts, presents one confirmation summary, then updates only the owned sections while preserving unrelated content.

evals.prompt: We added a new worker package and changed from npm to Bun. Refresh the agent engineering setup without auditing the code.
evals.expected_output: Updates documented commands and package layout, does not run an audit or propose architectural changes, and asks before optional Fallow or linter edits.

evals.prompt: Our package boundaries feel wrong. Run setup and redesign the monorepo into a clean architecture.
evals.expected_output: Limits setup to describing the current repository and redirects the architecture redesign request to ep-review-architecture.

evals.prompt: Set up engineering-principles skills in this Python repo. Confirm package responsibilities first.
evals.expected_output: Documents the Python package layout without editing application source.
